title: Mixed-universe leray transfers the base-change mate of a map of sheaf complexes
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y'\to Y$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ and projections $g_X:X'\to X$, $f':X'\to Y'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], $Lh^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], $Rh_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and canonical adjunctions and base-change map $\beta:L g^*R f_*\to R f'_*L g_X^*$ [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. Write $G_Z=R\Gamma(Z,-)$ [def-pc-global-derived-rhom], $S_h$ for exact restriction of global scalars, $e_h:G_SRh_*\cong S_hG_T$ for the canonical Leray comparison [lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso], and $s:S_fS_{g_X}\cong S_gS_{f'}$ for the scalar-square identification [def-pc-global-hom-pullback-comparison]. If $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, $E'\in D(\mathcal O_{X'})$, and $a:L g_X^*E\to E'$ is any morphism, write $\operatorname{adj}_h$ for the Hom bijection from $Lh^*\dashv Rh_*$. Then $$S_f\bigl(G_X(\operatorname{adj}_{g_X}(a));e_{g_X}(E')\bigr);s_{G_{X'}E'};S_g(e_{f'}^{-1}(E'))=e_f^{-1}(E);G_Y\bigl(\operatorname{adj}_g(\beta_E;Rf'_*(a))\bigr);e_g(Rf'_*E').$$ This is an identity for arbitrary sheaf complexes and maps; no internal-Hom or tensor-Hom input, and no isomorphism hypothesis on beta or a, is present. Sheaf localization universe w and module localization universe wA are independent.

proof.text: Apply mixedSectionsBaseChange_unit_square to E and precompose with inverse Leray for f. The inverse-hom identity cancels its Leray component. This gives the desired transport equation when a is the identity.

Cancel postcomposition by restricted Leray for f-prime at E-prime. Write each adjunction Hom transpose as its unit followed by direct image. Use Leray naturality at a, and naturality of the scalar-square isomorphism at global sections of a. These identify the general left path with the unit left path followed by the twice-restricted global sections of a. Naturality of Leray for g and f-prime identifies the right path with the unit right path followed by the same map. Substitute the unit equality and apply functoriality and associativity.

theorem mixedGlobalSections_baseChange_mate
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (E' : schemeDerivedCategory (pullback f g))
    (a : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E ⟶ E') :
    (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction f).map
        ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections X).map
          ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction (pullback.fst f g)).homEquiv _ _ a) ≫
          (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso (pullback.fst f g)).hom.app E') ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarSquareIso f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition).hom.app ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections (pullback f g)).obj E') ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
        ((mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso (pullback.snd f g)).inv.app E') =
    (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso f).inv.app E ≫
      (schemeDerivedGlobalSections Y).map
        ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _
          (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
            pullback.condition E ≫
            (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).map a)) ≫
      (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g).hom.app
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj E')
